questions: Do you also have sudden, involuntary jerking movements of your limbs or trunk?
Have you recently become unsteady when standing or walking?
Did the eye movements begin suddenly, over hours or days?
Have you recently had a fever or other infection?
Have you recently started, stopped, or taken too much of any medication or recreational drug?
Have you had confusion, unusual sleepiness, seizures, or loss of consciousness?
Have you had headaches, weakness, numbness, difficulty speaking, or difficulty swallowing?
Have you been diagnosed with cancer?
Have you had unexplained weight loss, night sweats, or persistent swollen lymph nodes?
Are you younger than 18 years old?
Have you recently received an immunization or developed an illness followed by these symptoms?
Do you have a history of autoimmune disease?
